name: Product Float In

behavior.description: Lift gently from below, drift once above the resting position, then settle. This is a finite entrance, not an idle loop.
behavior.targetSelection: Animate all product hooks within the selected component together.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds from start; a keyframe's easing controls the interval to the following keyframe.

adaptation: Translations are design pixels at 1080x1920 and scale with the frame; positive y is down. Scale is a multiplier of the authored base scale and rotation is additive in degrees, preserving fan and floating variant poses. Opacity is absolute. Use a composited motion layer without changing layout or decorative clipping. Initialize at the scheduled start and derive poses solely from local time; the final still pose replaces further drifting.
